TextBlock.Text: Destroy the coastal radar and military stores, then withdraw both strike aircraft.
A coastal radar and military stores compound support Russian operations near the western entrance to the Gulf of Aden. MiG-23MLD fighters and a short-range SA-13 defend the area.
WIDOW 1: two YF-23 B40S 20s strike aircraft, carrying four GBU-12s in total. WIDOW 2: two YF-23 B40 20s escorts. An E-2C provides early warning offshore.

Use WIDOW 2 to protect the strike. Assign the radar and stores compound between the bomb carriers. Avoid the short-range SAM and protect the nearby civilian communications site. After both targets are destroyed, bring both strike aircraft to STRIKE EXIT at 15,000 feet.

Win with both targets destroyed, both strike aircraft at STRIKE EXIT and no incoming weapons. Losing either strike aircraft or the civilian site fails the mission. Preserving both escorts and the Hawkeye earns a bonus.

Your assigned aircraft start airborne with finite fuel and loaded weapons. Fighter sections start line abreast, one nautical mile apart; strike pairs use Vic. Give orders to the leader to control the section. Detach a wingman before assigning a separate task.

September 2025. A fictional Russian expeditionary force threatens shipping in the Gulf of Aden. The four missions are standalone scenarios. Older ships and aircraft remain in service in this alternate history. Requires only Sea Power and this mod.
